skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Jessica's combat outfit when she's out on missions. 
There's always a new hidden pocket to find somewhere unexpected, a true test of the wearer's memory.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The pockets of her combat outfit are stuffed with all kinds of miscellaneous bits and bobs. An additional yet unnecessary burden to bear. 
 She shoulders heavy responsibilities, and thus leaves clear and distinct footprints.

skins.name: 'Ride to Davistown'
skins.content: Collaborative Series/'Ride to Davistown'. Clothes the rookie actress Jessica wore for her audition. Whether pointing a gun at someone else or at herself, she'd immediately tear up. Director Nian was real pleased.
skins.usage: One of Jessica the Liberated's costumes.
skins.quote: 'Y-You're threatening me because I'm a new actress?' 'Uhh, Laura, your butt won't hurt any longer.' 'We must learn to get along with these Laterans. We don't have a choice—' 'D-Director Nian, how was that?'
